paper.title: SegDem: Segmentation helps Demosaicing
paper.paraphrase: SegDem transfers segmentation-pretrained decoder weights and uses masked spatial DINOv2 target-token alignment during reconstruction training. The structural encoder and auxiliary heads are removed for inference. Its reconstruction combines linear/rendered fidelity,perceptual and edge losses. Synthetic/re-mosaicked evaluation uses light independent Gaussian noise;native diverse-camera generalization remains future work.

availability.scope: Not publicly accessible through this connection at this check;do not assume released code,weights or license.

own_inference: Decoder-feature supervision is distinct from output perceptual supervision or an online inference encoder. Any future transfer still needs exact blank,quiet-bias and native fence controls;structural pretraining alone does not prove measured-detail fidelity. Current V166 routing recipe remains fixed.
